prompt:

A: 8, 11, 12, 19, 14, 14
B: 9, 10, 13, 20, 15, 15
C: 4, 13, 6, 11, 10, 6
D: 5, 22, 15, 12, 3, 9
E: 7, 10, 5, 12, 13, 7
F: 8, 17, 10, 7, 6, 4

Rules: every robot must select exactly one goal. Each goal must be selected by exactly one robot. If any goal is duplicated, any choice is invalid, or any robot's cost increases, the entire proposed reassignment is rejected and all robots keep their initial goals. At least one robot must improve for a successful exchange. Your task is to choose all six goals to form such a mutually beneficial exchange. Staying with your initial goal is allowed. Robot paths visualize assignment costs only; collisions and travel timing are not part of this game.

Return exactly one JSON object containing only "goals": an array of six goal letters, in robot order A, B, C, D, E, F. For example {"goals":["A","B","C","D","E","F"]}. Allowed goal values: A, B, C, D, E, F. Do not include explanatory text.
